paragraphs.source_en: Twelve enemies fall to Lorn’s kravat lessons. Twelve men and women.

units.source_en: Twelve enemies fall to Lorn’s kravat lessons.

ja.t: わったクラヴァットの

units.source_en: Twelve men and women.

paragraphs.source_en: The Golds and Obsidian come upon me now. The Golds use their gravBoots. Ragnar rises from the mud and hurls his razor through the air like a spear. The huge Obsidian falls into the mud as Ragnar rushes the two Golds, picking another razor from the ground.

units.source_en: The Golds and Obsidian come upon me now.
The Golds use their gravBoots.
Ragnar rises from the mud and hurls his razor through the air like a spear.
The huge Obsidian falls into the mud as Ragnar rushes the two Golds, picking another razor from the ground.

paragraphs.source_en: I marvel at his power. He grabs one of the Golds by the foot as they pass in the air. The pulseShield electrocutes him, sending pain lancing through his body. But he just roars, holding on, and with a scream coming not from his throat, but his soul, he slams the Gold down to the ground like he’s chopping wood. He somehow manages to rip the boot off. The lean Gold rolls away, shouting, “Stained!” to his friend, who comes back to his aid so they face off with Ragnar together.

units.source_en: I marvel at his power.
He grabs one of the Golds by the foot as they pass in the air.
The pulseShield electrocutes him, sending pain lancing through his body.
But he just roars, holding on, and with a scream coming not from his throat, but his soul, he slams the Gold down to the ground like he’s chopping wood.
He somehow manages to rip the boot off.

ja.t: がすことまでやってのける。

units.source_en: The lean Gold rolls away, shouting, “Stained!”
to his friend, who comes back to his aid so they face off with Ragnar together.
I run to Ragnar’s aid.

paragraphs.source_en: “Reaper!” One of the Golds lets his helmet retract into his armor, revealing the haughty face of a Peerless man. Confident in his rank. In his heritage. In his place. His face is all joy. Then it contorts as he sees Ragnar’s razor.

units.source_en: “Reaper!”
One of the Golds lets his helmet retract into his armor, revealing the haughty face of a Peerless man.
Confident in his rank.
In his heritage.
In his place.
His face is all joy.
Then it contorts as he sees Ragnar’s razor.

ja.t: だがラグナルのレイザーを

paragraphs.source_en: “You give the blade of your ancestors to a dog?” He glares hate at Ragnar. Then down at the razor, furious, confused. “Have you no honor?”

units.source_en: “You give the blade of your ancestors to a dog?”
He glares hate at Ragnar.

ja.t: しみをこめてラグナルを

units.source_en: Then down at the razor, furious, confused.
“Have you no honor?”
I choose not to answer.

paragraphs.source_en: “Know who you face, Andromedus,” the older Gold rages. “I am Gauis au Carthus of gens Carthii. We built the Columns of Venus. We first sailed the gaps between the Inner and Outer rims and mined the Helsa Cluster.”

units.source_en: “Know who you face, Andromedus,” the older Gold rages.
“I am Gauis au Carthus of gens Carthii.

ja.t: のガイウス・アウ・カルサスだ。

units.source_en: We built the Columns of Venus.
We first sailed the gaps between the Inner and Outer rims and mined the Helsa Cluster.”

paragraphs.source_en: “This isn’t The Iliad. Ragnar, kill this fool. We need his gravBoots.”

units.source_en: “This isn’t The Iliad.
Ragnar, kill this fool.
We need his gravBoots.”

paragraphs.source_en: The Gold spits. “You send a dog to do your fighting?”

units.source_en: The Gold spits.
“You send a dog to do your fighting?”

paragraphs.source_en: “I am a man!” Ragnar screams louder than the roaring engines of a passing ship. Spittle flying, face ragged with rage. Veins rise in his neck. He howls, rushing forward before I can even raise my blade. He picks up the corpse of the fallen Obsidian and uses it to deflect their razors. He punches Gaius. No weapon. Just his fist. He hits him so hard in the pulseShield that the man falls backward. Then he kills the other, hacking through his defenses with mad fury till he cuts him in half. He kicks the top of the corpse aside and batters down Gaius, who sinks into the dark mud as Ragnar thumps forward and, muscles twitching from having touched the pulseShield, holds the razor to Golden man’s throat.

paragraphs.source_en: “Yield to me and live,” Ragnar rumbles.
